source_review.notes: Checked all six references for identity, dates, and bounded support. Google SRE sources support early declaration, command/operations/communications/planning roles, recursive delegation, a recognized command post, a live incident document, explicit handoff, and the distinction between managing and resolving an incident. The current Google incident guide supports command, control, communication, and the IC/communications/operations structure. FEMA NIMS Third Edition (October 2017) supports modular organization, contextual span of control, and briefing plus notification during command transfer; the chapter treats these as calibration rather than software law. NIST SP 800-61r3 was finalized April 2025 and supports integrating cybersecurity incident response with risk management. All six canonical URLs returned HTTP 200 on 2026-09-06.
